> Use one issue per asset (or per tightly related asset group). Results feed
> back into `docs/ASSET_REVIEW.md`. Until an asset is **cleared** or
> **replaced**, treat it as restricted — no public or commercial use.

## Asset path

<!-- e.g. public/models/plant-cell-first001.glb -->

## Asset type

<!-- GLB 3D model / rendered image / preview image / AI-generated image / icon /
     demo media / other -->

## Source

<!-- Where it came from: upstream path, URL, repository, dataset, tool. -->

## Author / provider

<!-- Original author or provider, if known. "Unknown" is a valid answer. -->

## Current license

<!-- Declared licence, or "unknown". Link/quote the licence text if available. -->

## Commercial use allowed?

- [ ] Yes
- [ ] No
- [ ] Unknown / needs verification

## Attribution required?

- [ ] Yes (specify the exact required attribution)
- [ ] No
- [ ] Unknown

## Modification allowed?

- [ ] Yes
- [ ] No
- [ ] Unknown

## Replacement needed?

- [ ] Yes — needs replacement/re-sourcing
- [ ] No — can be kept as-is (with attribution if required)
- [ ] Undecided

## Review result

<!-- Final determination: cleared / cleared-with-attribution / blocked / replace.
     Include reasoning and links to evidence (licence pages, dataset terms). -->

## Notes

<!-- Anything else: entry IDs (e.g. NIH 3D 3DPX-xxxxx), model output terms,
     replacement candidates, etc. -->
